# Signed-manifest fixture for cross-language verification

Generated by the Python signer (`infra/persona-manifest/sign_manifest.py`
canonical-bytes contract) and verified by the Rust verifier
(`packages/l6-persona/src/manifest_verifier.rs`). Locks signer ↔
verifier interop.

Files:
- signed_manifest.json   — full manifest with `ed25519:<base64>`
                           signature populated
- release_public_key.bin — 32 raw bytes (Ed25519 public key)
- release_public_key.b64 — base64 of the public key

Regeneration: re-run the inline Python in the
`l6(persona): cross-language fixture` commit (or just `python` with
the snippet from that commit message). The seed is hardcoded
([7] * 32) so re-running is deterministic.

Do NOT use the seed-derived key as a real release key.
